paragraphs.text: Elmegraun was one of Shanna 's crew on the Weatherlight prior to its Compleation .

Elmegraun was a member of the Weatherlight 's engine room crew. Their role as part of the engine room staff suggests they possessed technical knowledge and skills essential for maintaining and repairing the ship's systems. Elmegraun accompanied Velena and Arvad when they sought out Shanna and the others after the Weatherlight experienced a catastrophic malfunction. They encountered Shanna's group along a trail, with Velena urgently trying to communicate the dire situation regarding the ship. However, before Velena could fully explain, they were attacked by a barrage of sickly green powerbolts. Elmegraun, like Velena, was caught in the attack and melted into a puddle, perishing instantly.
